definitions.explanation: Synthetic material used for clear plastic sheets, paints, and fibers in clothing. From English "acryl(ic)."

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アクリル⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧だ。
examples.english: This sweater is made of acrylic.

examples.japanese: アクリル⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕切|しき}り→仕切り：11431_shikiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a partition out of acrylic sheets.

examples.japanese: アクリル⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Acrylic paints dry quickly, so they are easy to use even for beginners.

notes:
Loanword covering both the transparent rigid plastic (often called plexiglass in English) and synthetic fiber used in clothing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アクリル⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧: acrylic sheet, plexiglass panel
- アクリル⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧: acrylic paints
- アクリル⟦{樹脂|じゅし}→樹脂：17424_jushi⟧: acrylic resin
- アクリル{毛|げ}{糸|いと}: acrylic yarn
- アクリル⟦{繊維|せんい}→繊維：13857_seni⟧: acrylic fiber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧: plastic — generic term; アクリル is one specific type
- ⟦ポリエステル→ポリエステル：26376_poriesuteru⟧: polyester — different synthetic fiber, common in clothing alongside アクリル
